entry.title: Eggenberg Castle, Graz

Original picture-proportional sections use11.2m eave,22.2m main roof ridge,16m corner wall/35.3m lantern finial and39.5m central clock finial. These are approximate original envelopes,not surveyed as-built heights. Ground floor1.1m above371m datum clears the coarse field;front/rear bridge aprons adapt to host terrain rather than claiming surveyed historic grades. +X ESE toward front bridge/forecourt,-X WNW toward rear bridge/hillside;+Z SSW,-Z NNE;+Y up.
